panels.title: Jarvis system architecture — live health (M2 / M4 + services + data flow)
panels.description: Diagram-as-code (Graphviz DOT). M2 service nodes are colored by live host_health (green ok / amber warn / red down), matched node-id to service name; ${status} injected into labels. Neutral nodes (data stores, observability stack, external) are not health-probed. Refresh 30s.

targets.queryText: SELECT h.service AS id, CASE h.status WHEN 'ok' THEN '#1a7f37' WHEN 'warn' THEN '#9e6a03' WHEN 'down' THEN '#a40e26' ELSE '#30363d' END AS fillcolor, h.status AS status FROM host_health h JOIN (SELECT service, MAX(ts) mx FROM host_health GROUP BY service) m ON h.service=m.service AND h.ts=m.mx
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT h.service AS id, CASE h.status WHEN 'ok' THEN '#1a7f37' WHEN 'warn' THEN '#9e6a03' WHEN 'down' THEN '#a40e26' ELSE '#30363d' END AS fillcolor, h.status AS status FROM host_health h JOIN (SELECT service, MAX(ts) mx FROM host_health GROUP BY service) m ON h.service=m.service AND h.ts=m.mx

panels.title: Staff dispatch tree — last ${hours}h (5s refresh)
panels.description: Live top-down map (rankdir=TB) of which staff agents Jarvis has dispatched in the window: Jarvis at the root, edge thickness scaled by dispatch count. Source: agent_events 'subagent_dispatch' → vec-server /topology?format=dot → rendered by the Graphviz panel (Query mode). Polls every 5s. Widen the Window (hours) variable to see a longer history.
